users_identity_required.name: users_identity_required
users_identity_required.value: "users"."email_normalized" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."phone_normalized" IS NOT NULL

users_email_normalized.name: users_email_normalized
users_email_normalized.value: "users"."email_normalized" = lower(btrim("users"."email_normalized")) AND length("users"."email_normalized") BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND position('@' in "users"."email_normalized") > 1

users_verification_identity.name: users_verification_identity
users_verification_identity.value: ("users"."email_verified_at" IS NULL OR "users"."email_normalized" IS NOT NULL) AND ("users"."phone_verified_at" IS NULL OR "users"."phone_normalized" IS NOT NULL)

sync_time_order.name: sync_time_order
sync_time_order.value: "provider_syncs"."finished_at" IS NULL OR "provider_syncs"."started_at" IS NULL OR "provider_syncs"."finished_at" > "provider_syncs"."started_at"

sync_terminal_timestamp.name: sync_terminal_timestamp
sync_terminal_timestamp.value: ("provider_syncs"."state" = 'RUNNING' AND "provider_syncs"."finished_at" IS NULL) OR ("provider_syncs"."state" <> 'RUNNING' AND "provider_syncs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)

pricing_scope_target.name: pricing_scope_target
pricing_scope_target.value: (("pricing_rules"."scope" = 'GLOBAL' AND num_nonnulls("pricing_rules"."category_id", "pricing_rules"."brand_id", "pricing_rules"."product_id", "pricing_rules"."provider_id") = 0) OR (num_nonnulls("pricing_rules"."category_id", "pricing_rules"."brand_id", "pricing_rules"."product_id", "pricing_rules"."provider_id") = 1 AND (("pricing_rules"."scope" = 'CATEGORY' AND "pricing_rules"."category_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("pricing_rules"."scope" = 'BRAND' AND "pricing_rules"."brand_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("pricing_rules"."scope" = 'PRODUCT' AND "pricing_rules"."product_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("pricing_rules"."scope" = 'PROVIDER' AND "pricing_rules"."provider_id" IS NOT NULL))))

pricing_schedule.name: pricing_schedule
pricing_schedule.value: "pricing_rules"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "pricing_rules"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "pricing_rules"."ends_at" > "pricing_rules"."starts_at"

order_contact_required.name: order_contact_required
order_contact_required.value: "orders"."contact_email" IS NOT NULL OR "orders"."contact_phone" IS NOT NULL

payment_processing_completed_timestamp.name: payment_processing_completed_timestamp
payment_processing_completed_timestamp.value: "payment_event_processing"."state" NOT IN ('PROCESSED', 'IGNORED') OR "payment_event_processing"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL

attempt_terminal_timestamp.name: attempt_terminal_timestamp
attempt_terminal_timestamp.value: ("provider_attempts"."status" IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') AND "provider_attempts"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("provider_attempts"."status" IN ('CREATED', 'SUBMITTED', 'PENDING') AND "provider_attempts"."terminal_at" IS NULL)

provider_processing_completed_timestamp.name: provider_processing_completed_timestamp
provider_processing_completed_timestamp.value: "provider_event_processing"."state" NOT IN ('PROCESSED', 'IGNORED') OR "provider_event_processing"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL

flash_sale_schedule.name: flash_sale_schedule
flash_sale_schedule.value: "flash_sales"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "flash_sales"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "flash_sales"."ends_at" > "flash_sales"."starts_at"

promo_schedule.name: promo_schedule
promo_schedule.value: "promos"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "promos"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "promos"."ends_at" > "promos"."starts_at"

promo_positive_limits.name: promo_positive_limits
promo_positive_limits.value: ("promos"."quota" IS NULL OR "promos"."quota" > 0) AND ("promos"."per_user_limit" IS NULL OR "promos"."per_user_limit" > 0)

promo_value_for_type.name: promo_value_for_type
promo_value_for_type.value: ("promos"."type" IN ('FIXED_DISCOUNT', 'CASHBACK') AND "promos"."fixed_amount_idr" IS NOT NULL AND "promos"."fixed_amount_idr" > 0 AND "promos"."discount_bps" IS NULL) OR ("promos"."type" = 'PERCENTAGE_DISCOUNT' AND "promos"."fixed_amount_idr" IS NULL AND "promos"."discount_bps" IS NOT NULL AND "promos"."discount_bps" > 0) OR ("promos"."type" = 'FREE_ADMIN_FEE' AND "promos"."fixed_amount_idr" IS NULL AND "promos"."discount_bps" IS NULL)

referral_reward_state.name: referral_reward_state
referral_reward_state.value: ("referral_events"."state" IN ('REWARDED', 'REVERSED') AND "referral_events"."reward_idr" IS NOT NULL AND "referral_events"."reward_idr" > 0) OR ("referral_events"."state" NOT IN ('REWARDED', 'REVERSED') AND "referral_events"."reward_idr" IS NULL)

cms_banner_schedule.name: cms_banner_schedule
cms_banner_schedule.value: "cms_banners"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "cms_banners"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "cms_banners"."ends_at" > "cms_banners"."starts_at"

system_setting_value_shape.name: system_setting_value_shape
system_setting_value_shape.value:
("system_settings"."key" = 'PUBLIC_CONTACT' AND "system_settings"."value" ? 'email' AND jsonb_typeof("system_settings"."value"->'email') = 'string' AND ("system_settings"."value" - 'email' - 'phone') = '{}'::jsonb)
  OR ("system_settings"."key" = 'RECEIPT_COPY' AND "system_settings"."value" ? 'footer' AND jsonb_typeof("system_settings"."value"->'footer') = 'string' AND ("system_settings"."value" - 'footer') = '{}'::jsonb)
  OR ("system_settings"."key" = 'CATALOG_PAGE_SIZE' AND "system_settings"."value" ? 'count' AND jsonb_typeof("system_settings"."value"->'count') = 'number' AND ("system_settings"."value"->>'count') ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND ("system_settings"."value"->>'count')::numeric BETWEEN 12 AND 48 AND ("system_settings"."value" - 'count') = '{}'::jsonb)
